title: WebRun Browser Automation
description: Run multi-step tasks in a real Chrome browser: persistent environments, live view, human takeover.
summary: Run multi-step tasks in a real Chrome browser: persistent environments, live view, human takeover.
offersHint: Run multi-step tasks in a real Chrome browser: persistent environments, live view, human takeover. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.webrun.ai/mcp · Requires headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: WebRun API key as a bearer token.

variables.name: api_key
variables.description: WebRun API key (starts with wr_) from https://app.webrun.ai. Append :ENVIRONMENT_ID to attach a persistent environment that keeps its Chrome profile and logins across runs.

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: WebRun API key as a bearer token.

variables.name: api_key
variables.description: WebRun API key (starts with wr_) from https://app.webrun.ai. Append :ENVIRONMENT_ID to attach a persistent environment that keeps its Chrome profile and logins across runs.

toolsPreview.name: browser_task
toolsPreview.description: Execute a browser automation task in a real Chrome browser running in a WebRun cloud environment (docs.webrun.ai). Creates a session, runs the task, and auto-terminates. Best for simple one-off tasks. May navigate, fill forms, and submit data on third-party websites as the task requires.

toolsPreview.name: create_session
toolsPreview.description: Create a persistent session in a real Chrome browser running in a WebRun cloud environment (docs.webrun.ai), for multi-step workflows. Returns a sessionId for subsequent commands. With an initial task the browser may act on third-party websites immediately.

toolsPreview.name: send_task
toolsPreview.description: Send a new task to an existing browser session (from create_session). The real Chrome browser may navigate, fill forms, and submit data on third-party websites as the task requires.

toolsPreview.name: pause_session_task
toolsPreview.description: Pause the task currently running in a browser session. Resume it later with resume_session_task.

toolsPreview.name: resume_session_task
toolsPreview.description: Resume a previously paused task in a browser session.

toolsPreview.name: stop_session_task
toolsPreview.description: Cancel the task currently running in a browser session, keeping the session alive for new tasks.

toolsPreview.name: terminate_session
toolsPreview.description: End a browser session and free its resources. The session and any running task cannot be resumed afterwards.

toolsPreview.name: guardrail_response
toolsPreview.description: Respond to a guardrail trigger when the browser agent needs human input (credentials, clarification, approval). The response is handed to the live agent, which continues acting on it.

toolsPreview.name: get_task_status
toolsPreview.description: Check the status of a task previously started in a browser session. Use to poll for completion or detect guardrails. Read-only: reports on the task without affecting it.

toolsPreview.name: screenshot
toolsPreview.description: Capture a screenshot of the current browser page in an active session. Returns the screenshot as an inline image. Read-only.

toolsPreview.name: list_sessions
toolsPreview.description: List all active browser sessions for this account. Read-only.

toolsPreview.name: list_environments
toolsPreview.description: List available browser environments (persistent profiles) for this account. Returns environment IDs needed for persistent sessions in browser_task or create_session. Read-only.
